description:
Battle For Raka

A Foxhole inspired mod

Download :

https://drive.google.com/file/d/12NoNfEtJCZzVY4bydPZXaQCGqcwFyhvN/view?usp=drive_link

My first attempt at modding this game. I decided to take inspiration from a great game to create a somewhat complete faction mod.

In its current state, the mod may have bugs and can be pretty unbalanced. Feedback wanted!

What this mod has to offer :

- A New star system in the Core Worlds : Raka

- 2 New Faction : The Warden Alliance and the Mesean Republic

- 16 New variants of vanilla ships, coming with the Warden or Colonial Flavor

- 9 New hulls, 4 for each faction and 1 neutral

- 6 New weapon, 3 for each faction

- 6 New hullmods, with 4 "experimentals" one that drasticly change the way of playing your ship

Compatibility :

NOT safe to add to an existing save.

Should work with any mod. Let me know if its not the case.

Integrations

Basic Nexerelin compatibility, more work to be done here though

Credits

A big inspiration of course come from the amazing game Foxhole that has absorbed more hours than I'm willing to admit.

Go cheak it out at :

https://www.foxholegame.com/about-foxhole

Spoiler

- Callahan class Battleship

- Blacksteel class Cruiser

- Ronan class Gunship

- Poseidon class Carrier

- Conqueror class Cruiser
